description: The image is a cross-section drawing titled "Diagram 4.4 Floor treatment 1 – high window head detail". It depicts the structural relationship between a window and two levels of ceiling construction. The upper level, marked by a line labeled "Original ceiling level", shows a roof or floor joist structure with cross-hatched insulation. Below this is a second layer labeled "Independent ceiling level". This lower structure includes a recessed area on the left, identified by a label as the "Pelmet recess", which sits between the window frame and the main ceiling body. The insulation within this lower section is illustrated using a pattern of overlapping circles. On the far left edge, the profile of a window frame and sill is visible. The bottom right corner of the drawing is labeled "SECTION".
